value: CREATE TABLE control(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, epoch INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE events(seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE meta(version INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE outbox(task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, state TEXT NOT NULL, claim_id TEXT, generation INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE ownership(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, owner TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE receipts(request_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, scope TEXT NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE records(kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(kind,id))
CREATE TABLE simulation_effects(task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, claim_id TEXT NOT NULL)
